Team Scholaris uses SwiftLaTeX pdfTeX for browser-side compilation.

Unmodified engine artifacts: SwiftLaTeX release v20022022 (20 February 2022).
Copyright notices and component licenses are retained in the upstream source.

Scholaris adapter: scholaris-worker.js (14 September 2026); separate source file.
Package files/fonts are downloaded on demand from https://texlive.texlyre.org,
operated by TeXlyre. Requests include package filenames and your IP address.
Document source is compiled in worker memory; it is not submitted to a compilation server.
Generated auxiliary files and bibliography source are not requested from the package server.
Package availability depends on this external service; first compilation needs internet access.
Individual TeX packages and fonts retain their respective upstream licenses.

PDF preview: Mozilla PDF.js, Apache-2.0 license.
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
